description.purpose: Telegram delivery sink for the digest: takes the last assistant turn and sends it to context.chat_id. Inbound user messages to the digest bot are not part of this design: they leave via emit_to to ./void, the silent terminal that emits nothing. Nothing here dead-letters -- /colony/dead_letters is the READ endpoint, never a discard.
description.use_when: As the terminal cell of a push pipeline (no inbound conversation expected).
description.not_in_scope: No conversation handling, no command parsing — this proxy is delivery-only by topology.
description.emits_meaning: Nothing into the pipeline by design (pure sink; inbound user messages leave via emit_to to the silent ./void terminal - S1 addendum: /colony/dead_letters is the READ endpoint, not a discard).
description.consumes_meaning: messages[]: last assistant turn is sent. context.chat_id (number) selects the chat — promoted from the format cell's hop.
